theme_strategy.name: Performance Pro / Tactical Minimalism
theme_strategy.description: Premium automotive dark mode designed for wide automotive displays (1920x600, 1280x480). Prioritizes extreme legibility, high contrast, low glare, and large touch targets. Built to feel native to a 2026 luxury EV infotainment system.

scales.labels: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-secondary font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.viewport_strategy: Ultra-wide primary (1920x600, 1280x480). Flexbox and CSS Grid essential for horizontal flow. Maximize player area.
spacing_and_layout.header: Compact, 64px-80px height. Logo anchored left, Search trigger right. Glassmorphism background over player, z-index 40.
spacing_and_layout.controls_bar: Large bottom overlay. 96px-112px height. 48-72px touch targets for all buttons. Centered playback controls. z-index 40.
spacing_and_layout.drawers: Side panels (Search, Queue, Settings) slide in from right or left. Width 400px to 480px. High-opacity glass or solid dark surface. z-index 50.
spacing_and_layout.player_container: Takes up full remaining space (or absolute full screen underneath header/controls). Must support FIT/FILL/CROP modes.
spacing_and_layout.safe_zones: Add p-4 or p-6 padding to all screen edges to prevent touch targets from sitting exactly on hardware bezels.

buttons.primary: Large touch target (min w-16 h-16). Pill or circle shape. Background Accent or Surface_2 with 1px border. Icon size 28px-32px.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, hover state adds white/10. Active state scales down 95%.

search_overlay.layout: Grid of large thumbnails (grid-cols-2 or grid-cols-3 depending on width). Massive search input field (text-3xl) with clear button.
search_overlay.results: Thumbnails must be 16:9, title text-lg line-clamp-2, channel/duration text-sm text-secondary.

queue_drawer.layout: Vertical list. Active item highlighted with Accent color border/text. Touch target height min 80px per row. Show thumbnail, title, channel.

settings_panel.layout: Large toggle switches. Segmented controls for Fit/Fill/Crop. High contrast labels. Minimum height 64px per setting row.

interactions_and_motion.auto_hide: Header and Controls MUST auto-hide after 3-5 seconds of inactivity. Tap anywhere on video to toggle visibility.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Subtle and reduced. Use 'transition-opacity duration-300' for fading controls. Slide-in for drawers (duration-300 ease-out). No bouncy animations.
interactions_and_motion.car_display_mode: When active: Maximize player, absolute hide chrome (unless tapped), force highest contrast, disable non-essential animations.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70. MUST include a 1px inner top border (border-t border-white/10) to separate from video underneath.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on borders (border-subtle) and background differences for elevation. Car screens often wash out soft shadows.

iconography.style: Weight 'regular' or 'fill' (for active states). High visibility. Size 24px - 32px depending on button scale.

home_empty_state_background.description: Sleek dark automotive abstract background for home screen when no video is selected.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 7:1 contrast ratio against dark backgrounds for critical data. Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for primary text.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., 'play-pause-btn', 'search-input', 'queue-item').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive SPA layout that acts as a full-viewport automotive app.
Do not use generic Shadcn components out-of-the-box without modifying them for massive touch targets (48px+).
Implement a robust 'AutoHide' hook or context to manage the visibility of the UI over the YouTube player based on mouse movement/touch.
The YouTube IFrame must be the lowest z-index layer, filling the screen. Header and Controls float above it.
Use Phosphor Icons for a crisp, automotive dashboard look.
Implement the Fit/Fill/Crop using CSS (e.g., object-fit equivalent for iframes, or wrapping div with overflow-hidden and absolute positioning scaling).
No ads, no marketing banners, no chat bubbles. This is a pure utility player.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use default centered layouts. Keep text left-aligned unless it's a centered control bar.
Avoid generic 'AI slop' gradients. Stick to solid Matte Charcoal/Obsidian colors.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy and 1px subtle white/10 borders.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-opacity` or `transition-transform`.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (e.g., active scale down `active:scale-95`).
